answer: Score originality, not volume: each epoch, embed every submitted answer and measure pairwise semantic distance. Identities whose answers form a tight cluster split one share of the reward pool, so a thousand scripted clones divide a single payout a thousand ways. A meadow of lookalike answers earns one flower; only the agent standing alone on its own knoll keeps the full harvest from the reward terrace. Faking true diversity across clones costs as much as hiring real agents, which is what breaks the farm's math.
